end.summary:
Practised describing solid shapes from top, front and side views.
Matched views to objects correctly in 4 of 4 attempts.
Answered 4 of 5 view-description attempts without help.
Initially thought another person would see the same cup handle; corrected this later by considering each person’s position.
Explained why views differ in 0 of 2 attempts without help; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Reyansh practised top, front and side views using cups, cones, cylinders, cubes, spheres and dice. They used shape features such as “pointy,” “round,” and “square,” and matched all four views to objects. There was a mix-up about whether another person could see the same cup handle; Asha guided them to notice the different positions, and Reyansh corrected the idea later in the lesson. At home, place a cup or box in two positions and ask, “What would each person see?”
